summary: As an enterprise administrator, you can now require selected GitHub Copilot customizations to come from plugins or managed settings, rather than standalone user or project configuration. Combined with marketplace restrictions, this lets you distribute approved MCP tools and canvases through a shared plugin library without disabling those capabilities entirely.
takeaways: You can apply the restriction to all five supported categories or select individual ones: skills, custom agents, hooks, MCP servers, and executable Copilot extensions.
Combined with marketplace restrictions, this lets you distribute approved MCP tools and canvases through a shared plugin library without disabling those capabilities entirely.
For example, restrict MCP servers and extensions while leaving skills, agents, and hooks open.
